notes: Idea: let people take Shed Designer's model out of the page, since it is the tool page with the most real visits (site-visits.json). Built gltf.mjs, a binary glTF 2.0 writer with no library: every piece is a named node grouped by layer, in metres, Y up. Added a lazy-loaded button, the usage event models-saved, unit tests on all 9 presets, and a browser download test. Khronos glTF Validator 2.0.0-dev.3.10 (npm, in the scratchpad, not a dependency) found 0 errors and 0 warnings on all 9 presets. three.js loaded the 8x12 and rendered it: 3.76 m long, nine layer groups. Verification: node --test gltf.test.mjs gave 12/12; browser.test.mjs '3D model downloads' and 'Save picture' passed; run_venture_tests.py shed-designer: 530 tests, 0 failed (3 skipped for lack of axe-core), 215 s. Next if used: IFC (typed framing members) or USDZ for AR. run_workflow_locally --for-changes: 13 of 14 workflows passed locally. ventures-tests failed only on the tsc step, which is now fixed. agent-cross-review has no runnable steps, and the deploy jobs did not run locally.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
